WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline_avg
  FROM signals
), status_avgs AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS status_avg
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
), kept AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_avgs AS sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.status_avg > b.baseline_avg
)
SELECT rfistat, status_avg, status_avg - baseline_avg AS above_baseline,
       status_avg - AVG(status_avg) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
